description: Vendor 1-minute OHLCV bars exactly as received, unadjusted. One part file per ingestion batch; a re-fetch appends a new part, never overwrites. Readers resolve duplicates by the latest ingested_at not after their as_of time.

columns.name: volume
columns.description: Shares, as reported by the feed.

columns.name: vwap

columns.name: feed
columns.description: sip | iex | ibkr_trades. Live IEX and historical SIP are different distributions (P0 audit A5.7).

columns.name: request_id
columns.description: sha256 of the canonical request (endpoint + params) that produced the row.

columns.name: ingested_at
